DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>: A named file consolidation job. Multiple groups can be configured and processed independently.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.file_keys: Configuration for archive extraction and file consolidation.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.file_keys.source_directory: Existing source directory containing files, folders and archives. Ordinary files are moved, not copied.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.file_keys.destination_directory: Separate destination directory where files are consolidated. Created if necessary. Filename collisions are resolved by appending a numeric suffix.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.file_keys.archive_extensions: List of archive extensions to search for. Supports ZIP and TAR variants. RAR and 7z are not supported. An empty list disables archive extraction.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.organization_keys: Configuration for organizing consolidated files into directories based on their file extensions.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.organization_keys.music: Configuration for music and audio files.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.organization_keys.unknown: Configuration for files that remain after the other file categories have been processed.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.organization_keys.<CATEGORY>.dir: Destination directory for the specified file category. Created if necessary.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.organization_keys.<CATEGORY>.ext: List of file extensions belonging to the specified category. Extension matching is case-insensitive.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.organization_keys.unknown.extens: An empty list collects all remaining files. The unknown category is processed last.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.year_keys: Configuration for organizing files into year directories.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.year_keys.directories: List of directories to organize by file modification year. Only files directly within each specified directory are processed.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.month_keys: Configuration for organizing files into month directories within existing year directories.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.month_keys.directories: List of directories containing year subdirectories to organize by month.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.month_keys.year_patterns: Glob patterns used to identify year directories. The default patterns match years from 1900 to 2099.
DESCRIPTION.Consolidate Files: Recursively find and extract archives, then move ordinary files into a flat destination directory. Original archives and empty source directories are retained.
DESCRIPTION.Remove Duplicate Files: Recursively search the destination directory for files with identical binary contents. Uses SHA-256 fingerprints and binary comparison to identify duplicates. Redundant copies are permanently deleted regardless of their filenames.
DESCRIPTION.Organize Files: Move files from the top level of the consolidation directory into their configured file category directories. Remaining files are moved into the Unknown directory.
DESCRIPTION.Organize Files by Year: Move files into year subdirectories using their last modification date. Year directories are created automatically.
DESCRIPTION.Organize Files by Month: Move files within existing year directories into month subdirectories using their last modification date. Month directories use the format MM-Month, such as 01-January and 12-December.
DESCRIPTION.Run All: Execute archive extraction, file consolidation, duplicate removal, organization by file extension, organization by year and organization by month in sequence.
DESCRIPTION.Archives: Archives are extracted within the source directory. Nested archives are also processed. Original archives are retained and recognized archives are excluded from the final file move.
DESCRIPTION.Filename Collisions: Files with matching destination filenames receive numeric suffixes such as _1 and _2 to prevent overwriting existing files.
DESCRIPTION.Duplicate Detection: Duplicate detection compares actual file contents rather than filenames, file extensions or modification dates. Files with different binary contents are retained.
DESCRIPTION.File Dates: Year and month organization use filesystem modification timestamps rather than creation timestamps. ZIP extraction may not preserve original modification timestamps.
DESCRIPTION.Repeated Execution: Retained archives may be extracted again when consolidation is repeated. Remove Duplicate Files can be used to remove identical copies.
DESCRIPTION.Warning: File consolidation and organization move files from their existing locations. Duplicate removal permanently deletes redundant files. Ensure important files are backed up before execution.
